# synapse-pangea-chat

Unified Synapse module (Python 3.10+) bundling all Pangea Chat server-side features into `synapse_pangea_chat.PangeaChat`.

For Synapse Admin API, Module API, and Matrix spec documentation links, see [synapse-docs.instructions.md](../../.github/.github/instructions/synapse-docs.instructions.md).

## Architecture

Single entry-point class `PangeaChat` (`synapse_pangea_chat/__init__.py`) composes sub-modules. Each sub-module lives in its own sub-package under `synapse_pangea_chat/`.

**Sub-modules**: `public_courses/` ([design](instructions/public-courses.instructions.md)), `room_preview/` ([design](instructions/room-preview.instructions.md)), `activity_session_previews/` ([design](instructions/activity-session-previews.instructions.md)), `room_code/` ([design](instructions/knock-with-code.instructions.md)), `assign_room_membership/` ([design](instructions/assign-room-membership.instructions.md)), `delete_room/`, `delete_user/` + `export_user_data/` ([design](instructions/delete-user-export-user-data.instructions.md)), `find_user_by_email/` ([design](instructions/find-user-by-email.instructions.md)), `course_member_emails/` ([design](instructions/course-member-emails.instructions.md)), `member_analytics_profiles/` ([design](instructions/member-analytics-profiles.instructions.md)), `user_activity/` ([design](instructions/user-activity.instructions.md)), `limit_user_directory/` + `user_directory_search/` ([design](instructions/limit-user-directory.instructions.md)), `email_invite/` ([invitations sent before seats](instructions/student-invitations.instructions.md#invitations-sent-before-seats), [create_course_space](instructions/create-course-space.instructions.md)), `register_email/` ([design](instructions/register-email.instructions.md)), `direct_push/` + `notice_delivery/` ([design](instructions/notice-delivery.instructions.md)), `delayed_push/` ([design](instructions/delayed-push.instructions.md)), `direct_message/` ([design](instructions/ensure-direct-message.instructions.md)), `email_policy/` ([design](instructions/email-address-policy.instructions.md)), `grant_instructor_analytics_access/` ([design](instructions/grant-instructor-analytics-access.instructions.md)), `analytics_forward/` — the dashboard's Matrix inputs pushed to admin-dash-api ([design](instructions/analytics-forward.instructions.md)), `preview_with_code/` (no design doc yet), `blocked_join_gate/` ([design](instructions/blocked-join-gate.instructions.md)), `course_default_chats/` ([design](instructions/course-default-chats.instructions.md)), `course_session_admins/` — joins a course's admins to its new activity sessions ([design](instructions/course-session-admins.instructions.md)), `set_course_plan/` ([design](instructions/set-course-plan.instructions.md)), `migrate_course_can_dos/` — one-off move of course spaces ([design](instructions/migrate-course-can-dos.instructions.md)) and learners' progress records ([design](instructions/migrate-course-progress.instructions.md)) to the merged Can-Dos, `discussion_room/` — places a student in a discussion room (creating it as the bot), previews where Join would place them, and ends or reopens their seat ([design](instructions/discussion-room.instructions.md)), `quest_courses/` — which course spaces and unclaimed courses use each quest, read by the CMS ([design](instructions/quest-courses.instructions.md)), `safety_incidents/` — the Safety page's report and read endpoints ([design](instructions/moderation.instructions.md#the-safety-pages-record)), `student_invitations/` — seat invitations, the claim and approvals ([design](instructions/student-invitations.instructions.md)), `lti/` — the Canvas LTI 1.3 tool, unreleased ([design](instructions/lti-tool.instructions.md)), plus the module-level `unassign_activity_role_on_leave.py` (no design doc yet) and `analytics_push_suppression.py` ([design](instructions/analytics-room-push-suppression.instructions.md)), shared by the two endpoints that invite into analytics rooms

## Key Files

- **Entry point**: `synapse_pangea_chat/__init__.py` — `PangeaChat` class, registers all resources & callbacks
- **Config**: `synapse_pangea_chat/config.py` — `PangeaChatConfig` (attrs, all keys optional with defaults)
- **Config parsing**: `PangeaChat.parse_config()` in `__init__.py`
